title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 106. Stresses the need for the aviation sector to align with global climate goals, particularly the 1.5 °C target set by the Paris Agreement; is concerned by the slow progress achieved by the International Civil Aviation Organization in addressing emissions from international aviation; considers that its Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA) should continue efforts to align with the 1.5 °C trajectory;
